motion.name: plate-out
motion.purpose: Old plate dropping out of its slot.

motion.name: plate-in
motion.purpose: New plate dropping into its slot, staggered 45ms.

components.name: Plate
components.description: A chalk tin plate on the pitch board.
components.css: .ds-board { background: oklch(0.32 0.06 165); padding: 24px; display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-plate { display: inline-block; background: oklch(0.97 0.008 160); color: oklch(0.2 0.025 165); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 56px; line-height: 0.95; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.1em 0.14em 0.06em; } .ds-plate-live { background: oklch(0.83 0.16 85); color: oklch(0.25 0.05 80); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, bottom of the sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.32 0.06 165); color: oklch(0.98 0.006 160); height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 16px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.32 0.06 165 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.45 0.08 165 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.015 160); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 16px 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.2 0.025 165); background: transparent; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.45 0.08 165); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.45 0.08 165 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: A pitch-green board of chalk tin plates over a calm scorecard sheet. The board is loud, the sheet is plain.

rules.name: The One Marigold Rule
rules.body: At most one marigold plate per board; it means live.

rules.name: The Plates-Only Display Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders only on the board.

dos: Put the one changing value on a plate and swap it.
donts: No shadows, gradients, glass or food-photo chrome.
No kicker above a sheet headline.
